name: Minotaurs
description: The horde that ambushes the Alamon, hunts them deliberately and builds a wall around Akros to besiege it.

timeline.summary: The scholar Zerili argues for a treaty with the minotaurs and is found murdered and mutilated that week.
timeline.quote: the young man's mutilated corpse was found later that week

timeline.summary: Vinack offers himself as sacrifice to the oracle, who crushes and snaps his body, and a blood mist fills the minotaurs while the narrator thinks he sees Mogis.
timeline.quote: Without ceremony, the shaman slammed his fist downwards on Vinack's head, pushing it down into his body.

timeline.summary: The squad finds nine beheaded, butchered Akroans in the pass, including Captain Eumalos, and Xanthos identifies minotaur tracks.
timeline.quote: There were nine Akroans lying on the ground, their bodies already bloating in the heat.

timeline.summary: Boulders fall behind the squad, sealing the canyon, and a minotaur horde led by a huge sword-wielding brute charges them.
timeline.quote: From ahead of them came the sound of savage cries and thundering hooves, and then the first minotaurs rounded the corner.

timeline.summary: Xanthos is split from shoulder to thigh by a minotaur's axe while protecting Haemon.
timeline.quote: The axe fell, and split him from shoulder to thigh.

timeline.summary: Mnesos is gutted by a minotaur and is lost behind the horde; Leandros finds his trampled body later.
timeline.quote: Mnesos fell to the ground, moaning, blood seeping from his stomach.

timeline.summary: The minotaur leader joins the fight, severs Nikasios's leg and hurls Haemon against the canyon wall with a sickening crack.
timeline.quote: Nikasios lurched to one side, but the minotaur struck his leg, severing it.

timeline.summary: Kyrillos rams his sword into the minotaur leader's gut, is slammed down and stomped, and the leader is beheaded by Pallas and Leandros, its body falling on Kyrillos, who dies.
timeline.quote: Pallas's sword made a great arc and severed the minotaur's head.

timeline.summary: The surviving minotaurs scatter after their leader falls.
timeline.quote: they had seen their leader fall, and they were scattering.

timeline.summary: Diocles realizes the minotaurs lured and trapped the squad deliberately and says Akros must be warned.
timeline.quote: The minotaurs are hunting the Alamon, deliberately.

timeline.summary: Leandros runs for a day and more past fallen Alamon squads and minotaur bands and reaches Akros at night.
timeline.quote: Occasionally he came upon squads of fallen Alamon

timeline.summary: Leandros discovers the minotaurs have built a wall around Akros to keep the Alamon out while besieging the city.
timeline.quote: A wall. Someone— minotaurs —had built a wall around Akros

timeline.summary: Ajani realizes the latest Champion may be Elspeth, and Lanathos says she was seen at Akros, besieged by minotaurs.
timeline.quote: After she slew Polukranos, the Champion was spotted at Akros, which has been besieged by a horde of minotaurs.

relations.quote: A cruel seer that was rumored to have the ear of Mogis directed the feral beasts

relations.note: His mutilated corpse was found after he asked to speak to them.
relations.quote: arms torn from his torso with the palms toward the sky

relations.note: Mogis is patron god of the minotaurs.
relations.quote: respective patrons of the Akroans and the minotaurs

relations.note: The minotaurs hunt and ambush the Alamon.
relations.quote: The minotaurs are hunting the Alamon, deliberately.

pages_say.description: Raiding minotaur tribes in the borderlands that demand human tribute.
The horde that ambushes the Alamon, hunts them deliberately and builds a wall around Akros to besiege it.
Raiders ranging more widely and in greater numbers than before and besieging Akros.
